status: builder research (packet R2-P1, Claude Opus 5.5), pending orchestrator review; every entry is provisional
scope: Green manure crops for year-plan slots (ROUND2_SPEC.md 1.2 item 4): dhaincha, sunn hemp and cowpea grown and ploughed in. No product, no price, revenue 0.

methods.retrieval: Pages read 2026-11-01 with curl (TLS verified). WebFetch refused agritech.tnau.ac.in (certificate check), so the text was extracted locally from the fetched HTML; the TNAU seed price page was read the same way.
methods.seasonLabel: Year-round windows ('grown in all seasons') are split into the project's season bands by start month, as in crop-agronomy.json methods.seasonLabel: summer 02-01..04-30, kharif 05-01..08-31, rabi 09-01..01-31. The split is a labelling convention, not a source value.
methods.irrigation: TNAU gives dhaincha and sunn hemp as grown in all seasons with an irrigation interval (dhaincha once in 15-20 days, sunn hemp once in 30 days), so their year-round windows carry condition 'irrigated': not used on rainfed fields, conditional on supplemental or unrecorded irrigation (windows.ts irrigationCompat). No rainfed window for dhaincha or sunn hemp was found in a Karnataka or Tamil Nadu source.
methods.nitrogen: nitrogenAddedKgPerHa is the N accumulated in the green manure biomass at 60 days (TNAU organic farming table). The column header prints no unit; kg/ha is read from the per-hectare dry-matter column beside it. Incorporation at 45 days accumulates less N; the source does not quantify it, so the single 60-day figure is kept as min = max.
methods.cost: costPerHa = mid seed rate x TNAU certified seed sale price (w.e.f. 01.10.2023). Sowing and ploughing-in costs are not sourced (the TNAU cost-of-cultivation pages list costs by input category, not by operation), so the engine adds ASSUMPTIONS.greenManureFieldOpsCostPerHa, which is null: the cost is the seed only and is understated (flagged on the slot).
methods.provisional: Every entry is provisional: the figures come from state package-of-practice pages (TNAU) and a 2011 district contingency plan (CRIDA Hassan), not from a district green manure plan.

crops.name: Dhaincha

nitrogenAddedKgPerHa.source: TNAU-ORG-GM Biomass production and N accumulation table, Sesbania aculeata
nitrogenAddedKgPerHa.note: Age 60 days, dry matter 23.2 t/ha (as printed; the magnitude reads like green matter), N accumulated 133 (unit not printed, kg/ha read). Single figure at 60 days.

seedRateKgPerHa.note: 'Green manure: 50 kg/ha' (seed purpose 20 kg/ha). TNAU-RICE-ORGANIC also gives 50 kg seeds/ha for in-situ green manure before rice.

seedPriceInrPerKg.note: Sale price Foundation 55, Certified 52, TFL 50 (Rs.; per kg as in the TNAU 2015 schedule for the same rows). A Tamil Nadu university outlet price, used for Karnataka too.

crops.waterNote: Irrigation once in 15-20 days (TNAU-GM-AGRONOMY); no seasonal water need in mm is sourced.

districtSupport.text: Lowland Paddy-fallow ... Lime application 200 kg/acre and Green manuring Sunhemp, Diencha

windows.note: 'Grown in all seasons when sufficient moisture is available'; irrigation once in 15-20 days. Year-round window split by season band (methods.seasonLabel).
TNAU (Tamil Nadu) general guidance applied to Karnataka; CRIDA-HAS p26 names dhaincha green manuring for Hassan lowland paddy-fallow. No Karnataka window was found.

daysToIncorporation.source: TNAU-ORG-GM Biomass production and N accumulation table, Cow pea
daysToIncorporation.note: The table gives the N figure at age 60 days; no cowpea-specific incorporation day was found. TNAU-COWPEA gives 50% flowering at 35-45 days for the current varieties.

nitrogenAddedKgPerHa.source: TNAU-ORG-GM Biomass production and N accumulation table, Cow pea
nitrogenAddedKgPerHa.note: Age 60 days, dry matter 23.2 t/ha (as printed), N accumulated 74 (unit not printed, kg/ha read).

seedRateKgPerHa.note: Grain-crop pure-stand seed rate (25 kg/ha; mixed crop 12.5). No green-manure seed rate for cowpea was found; green manure stands are often sown denser, so the seed cost may be understated.

seedPriceInrPerKg.note: Sale price Foundation 103, Certified 97, TFL 95 (Rs. per kg).

crops.waterNote: No seasonal water need in mm for cowpea grown as green manure is sourced.
